About Us

At Kids Hurt Too Hawai'i, we believe that children should not be alone in their grief and trauma. The best way to heal is within a supportive community.

Since its beginning in 2001, Kids Hurt Too Hawai'i has provided group support and training services to thousands of children, youth, caregivers, and providers.

  • MISSION

    To strengthen connections to the community by bringing together children, teens, and their parents impacted by grief and trauma in safe and healing ways.

  • VISION

    To restore healthy growth and development in children with grief and trauma, and stabilize families in crisis.

  • VALUES

    EXCELLENCE: Delivering what we promise and exceeding expectations.
    BE REAL: Honesty and integrity always.
    PASSION: Inspired to care about the individual, organization, and community.
    COLLABORATION: Value everyone and work together for the common good.
    DETERMINATION: Committed to giving our best in everything we do.
    RESPECT: We follow the Golden Rule in everything we do: "Do unto others..."

To learn more and stay in touch with KHTH activities, click here to join our mailing list.

Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi

The name “Kids Hurt Too” was chosen by children in 2006. In 2011, the official name of the organization became “Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi.” Since its beginning, Kids Hurt Too Hawaiʻi has provided group support and training services to thousands of children, youth, caregivers, and providers.
